title: Retro-Tahyon

scope.limitation: NARA RG615 accessible indexed/metadata material was searched, but the binary bulk ZIP corpus could not be exhaustively byte-scanned in the current environment.

executive_summary.finding: The archive establishes a research lineage from time-advanced solutions and tachyon speculation to reverse-information-flow and Decision Augmentation Theory. It does not establish a detected tachyon, a verified retrocausal channel, precognition as a physical fact, or a UAP tachyon mechanism.
three_levels_not_to_merge: FORMAL_PHYSICS: equations may admit advanced/FTL solutions
CARRIER_HYPOTHESIS: tachyon/wormhole/potential proposed as possible carrier
lineage: 1970: tachyon physics discussed; direct particle search negative
1976: Puthoff/Targ discuss advanced-potential solutions and cause/effect reversal while noting non-observation
1977: literal phrase causality-reversing tachyon appears as possible precognition mechanism
1987: advanced time (AT) solutions and pre-time-zero analysis proposed
1994: reverse information flow, tachyons and statistical causality discussed with explicit physical caveats and a failed CNS replication
1995: DAT formalizes a future-to-past informational/biased-sampling model rather than a demonstrated carrier
1995: operational evaluation/closure does not validate a reliable intelligence technology

documents.title: Tachyon physics background and direct search
documents.finding: Tachyons were treated as hypothetical faster-than-light objects; a classic search for uncharged FTL particles reported no evidence and upper limits.

documents.title: A Perceptual Channel for Information Transfer over Kilometer Distances
documents.finding: Advanced-potential solutions f(t+r/c) are discussed as formally reversing normal cause/effect ordering; the same discussion notes such advanced solutions are conventionally discarded because the corresponding physical events have not been observed.

documents.title: The State of the Art in Psychic Research / Electro-77 material
documents.finding: A causality-reversing tachyon or advanced-potential solutions are explicitly listed as possible mechanisms relevant to precognition.

documents.title: Secondary archival occurrence of the same tachyon passage
documents.finding: Repeats the causality-reversing-tachyon/advanced-potential precognition passage. It is a provenance witness, not an independent replication.

documents.title: Enhanced Human Performance Investigations
documents.finding: Advanced-potential solutions of Maxwell equations are discussed as a possible route into a precognitive realm, with interest in event distributions before as well as after time zero.
documents.topa_use: Historical precursor of a pre-event lag scan; a modern test must freeze lag windows before outcomes to control look-elsewhere effects.

documents.title: Phenomenological Research and Analysis: Final Report
key_points: Discusses a mathematically consistent tachyon/tardyon framework and asks whether a tardyon could briefly exist as a tachyon.
Uses reverse information flow as a heuristic description of precognition-like data.
Speculates about local statistical reversal of causality while causality holds on average.
Explicitly says Visser wormholes are not a theory of precognition.
Warns that brain functioning at room temperature has not been shown to provide the needed quantum system for EPR-style mechanism claims.
Calls an AP carrier theory premature because the AP database was less substantial.
documents.negative_replication: FY1992 did not reproduce the FY1988 CNS result; the authors judged the 1988 result likely spurious and explicitly retained AC does not exist as a possible explanation.

documents.title: Decision Augmentation Theory: Toward a Model of Anomalous Mental Phenomena
documents.archival_phrase: transfer of information from future to past
documents.finding: DAT models a biased decision/sampling process rather than a demonstrated force-like alteration of nature, and provides distinguishable predictions for informational versus force-like models.
caveats: Quantum explanations are described as premature without evidence for the relevant quantum behavior in the brain.
Macro-AP evidence is criticized for poor artifact control.

documents.title: Notes: Research Plan
key_points: DAT framed as statistical information leakage from the future
wormholes and stochastic causality proposed for investigation
document states theory and experiments had not confirmed that propagation

documents.title: A Comprehensive Research Plan for Anomalous Mental Phenomena
documents.finding: The plan discusses backward-in-time information as a research question, notes microscopic time reversal in physics, and proposes stochastic causality as a way to think about macroscopic precognition claims.

documents.title: Quantum Physics and Parapsychology — Precognition: A History of Things Future
documents.author: Gerald Feinberg
documents.finding: Feinberg discusses time-advanced solutions that would propagate information future-to-past, while noting that such solutions are normally excluded because they have not been experimentally observed. He speculates about a small advanced component in a memory-like model of precognition.
documents.caution: Feinberg's connection to tachyon physics does not by itself establish that he proposed a tachyon as the carrier in this precognition model.

documents.title: Views on Emerging Areas of Science and Technology
documents.finding: The hypothetical faster-than-light tachyon appears as an example of potentially revolutionary high-energy-physics research; this is context, not retrocausal evidence.

documents.title: STAR GATE closure/evaluation context
documents.finding: A 1995 draft recommendation considered terminating in-house remote-viewing capability; CIA's retrospective summary of the independent AIR evaluation says the results were too unreliable, inconsistent and sporadic for intelligence use.

negative_results_and_counterevidence: Direct classic search for uncharged faster-than-light particles: no evidence in the searched channel.
Advanced mathematical solutions were explicitly distinguished from observed physical events.
FY1992 CNS study failed to replicate the FY1988 result; earlier result judged likely spurious.
Quantum/EPR-to-brain mechanism explicitly treated as premature.
Vector/scalar propagation research plan states theory/experiments had not confirmed propagation.
1995 operational evaluation did not support a reliable intelligence capability.
No direct UAP-tachyon-retrocausality bridge found in accessible NARA RG615 indexed/metadata sweep.

topa_gates.name: PROSPECTIVE_PRE_EVENT_INFORMATION_GATE
topa_gates.design: Freeze target generator, scoring rule, lag window, sample size and stopping rule before future targets exist; test pre-target responses against an exact/permutation null on independent holdout.
topa_gates.falsifier: Effect disappears on holdout or after leakage controls.

topa_gates.name: TEMPORAL_KERNEL_GATE
topa_gates.design: Predeclare allowed lag kernel/family before seeing outcomes.
topa_gates.falsifier: Peak exists only after choosing the best lag post hoc.

topa_gates.name: DAT_VS_FORCE_MODEL_GATE
topa_gates.design: Vary human decision opportunities independently from physical generator parameters to separate information-selection from force-like models.

topa_gates.name: CARRIER_IDENTITY_GATE
topa_gates.design: Any tachyon-carrier claim requires a carrier-specific physical observable independent of anomalous statistics.
topa_gates.falsifier: Only an unusual p-value exists, with no tachyon-specific signature.

topa_gates.name: UAP_BRIDGE_GATE
topa_gates.design: Require a source-linked UAP event with a preregistered temporal/physical signature and control corpus; thematic proximity is insufficient.
topa_gates.falsifier: Link exists only through shared vocabulary or archive adjacency.

forbidden_inferences: CIA studied X -> CIA proved X
advanced solution -> information actually travels backward in time

janus_takeaway.short: Archive provenance for tachyon/advanced-time/future-to-past research is admitted. Physical tachyon, verified retrocausality and UAP linkage are not admitted.
